meta.title: Mae Bio Inspirations: Oyster Pearl Defense

chunks.title: Pearl Formation Biology
chunks.content: Pearl defense: oyster detects irritant in mantle, epithelial cells migrate to site, form pearl sac (isolation). Deposit prismatic base layer (rough calcite coating), then alternating nacre layers: aragonite platelets (hard, brick-like) + conchiolin protein (soft mortar). Each layer micrometers thick. Continuous for months-years. Key principles: encapsulate rather than destroy, reuse existing machinery (same cells that build shell), proportional response (small irritant = small pearl), transformation (irritant becomes structural part of organism). Ca2+ concentration drives secretion rate.

chunks.title: Pearl Defense Computational Model
chunks.content: Computational pattern: DETECT irritant -> ISOLATE (form containment boundary) -> COAT with base protective layer -> LAYER repeatedly (each layer = validation + context + constraint, each makes object safer) -> INTEGRATE when safety threshold met. Differs from rejection (block/discard) and sanitization (modify to remove danger). Pearl defense preserves original input intact while surrounding it with safety layers. PearledInput wrapper: original preserved + layers list + containment context. Safety score = sum of layer contributions. Releasable when score >= threshold.

chunks.title: Pearl Defense Mae Architecture Mapping
chunks.content: Proposed PearlDefense in defense/ module. Third path beyond InputValidator pass/reject: encapsulate-and-continue. Layers alternate hard validation (formal constraints) and soft context (provenance, trust scores). ThreatDetector determines layer count required. HAVEN flags inputs for pearling vs quarantine. MemoryCoordinator stores pearled inputs with full layer history. EndocrineSystem cortisol raises layer requirement under stress. AutoHealer examines layer history when pearled input causes damage. Novel capability: productive paranoia - work safely with suspicious-but-valuable inputs.
